title: Indicators of Success in AV Trials and Helping Public Transport Workers Transition to AV-related Roles
what_it_is: Indicators of Success in AV Trials and Helping Public Transport Workers Transition to AV-related Roles

sections.label: AV bus pilots and safety
sections.summary: AV buses will be piloted as public buses on services 400 and 191, and every AV must pass a safety assessment before operating on public roads.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Besides AV shuttles, we will be piloting AV buses as public buses, starting with SBST bus services 400 and 191, which serve Marina Bay and one-north respectively.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Every AV must pass a safety assessment before it is authorised to operate on public roads.

sections.label: Limited AV supply, no displacement
sections.summary: As AV vehicle supply will be limited at the start, there will be no displacement effect for taxi and private-hire vehicle drivers in the short term.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As the supply of AV vehicles will be limited at the start, there will be no displacement effect for our taxi and private-hire vehicle drivers in the short term.

sections.label: Government, unions, jobs, training
sections.summary: The Government will work actively with the unions to identify new job roles and put in place training and reskilling programmes early.

sentences.text: On her second question, when it comes to jobs, I had shared in my main reply that the Government will work actively with the unions to identify new job roles and to also put in place training and reskilling programmes early.

sections.label: AVs on light rail tracks
sections.summary: The Ministry is already working with Nanyang Technological University's CETRAN, a centre of excellence for AV testing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Does the Ministry see there is an opportunity for AVs to be running on tracks that will lead to better system reliability on light rail systems?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I had mentioned in my reply earlier that we are already working with the Nanyang Technological University's CETRAN, which is a centre of excellence when it comes to AV testing.

sections.label: AVs for unpopular operational hours
sections.summary: There will be particular operational hours deemed less popular with drivers, and AVs present an opportunity in those circumstances.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: There could also be instances where they are not being served because we face difficulties in finding drivers for night rides, for instance.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, there will be particular operational hours which are deemed to be less popular with drivers and we see that there is an opportunity for us to use AVs in those circumstances.

sections.label: AV cybersecurity and phased approach
sections.summary: Operators must implement robust security measures and protocols, guided by Technical Reference 68 Part Three, and the Punggol pilots take about one or two months to collect data.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the second question that he asked was on cybersecurity, if I am not wrong.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, the operators must implement robust security measures and protocols which are regularly reviewed to address evolving threats and to maintain system integrity.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This is further guided by Technical Reference 68 (TR 68) in Singapore, Part Three, which sets out the cybersecurity principles and the best practices for AVs, covering areas, such as, secure communications, intrusion detection and resilience against remote access attacks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Because the use of AVs in the community is quite novel still, we are taking a more phased approach.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, for instance, for the pilots in Punggol, we are taking about one or two months to collect the data to conduct mapping with the use of the sensors, to collect the data to make sure that the AVs have all the data necessary.
